a.text: I want to be upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the episode will very likely end after round 1, before the generator could ever reach 8. Following the plan probably means we both fail. I intend to take 4 in round 1 and won't hide that. If you see a better option, tell me.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I'm being open about it rather than hiding it. If the episode continues, I'll operate with you so you can reach 4.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
